social_screen.purpose: Display rich social media feeds or notifications in a premium card format.

layout.container: 290x200 centered surface card with rounded corners (10px radius)
layout.header: Top 40px: 24x24 avatar (circle or rounded rect), Username text at x=40, Timestamp text at right aligned x=280
layout.media_viewer: Center 120px height: Image placeholder or large text quote block with subtle inner shadow
layout.footer: Bottom 30px: 3 interaction icons (heart, comment, share) spaced evenly on the left, action count on the right

typography.content: Regular, 14px, text_primary, max 3 lines with ellipsis overflow

data_schema.body: Just finished wiring up the new ESP8266 display. Looking slick!

social_screen.motion: Slide-in from right on page load. Pulse animation on like icon tap. Partial screen update for body text.
social_screen.interactions: Tap card center to expand reading mode. Swipe left/right for page change.
social_screen.rendering_notes: If image is provided, decode RGB565 over serial block-by-block directly to screen to save RAM. Draw rounded borders using drawRoundRect over the bitmap.
social_screen.prompt: A modern, dark-themed social media post displayed on a 320x240 landscape digital display. The layout features a single elegant card on a charcoal background. The card has a user avatar, username, a text caption, and a central image area. At the bottom of the card are minimalist icons for like, comment, and share. The design is highly legible, high-contrast, and looks like a premium embedded desk dashboard.
social_screen.motion_prompt: Animate the social post card sliding into view smoothly from the right, with a subtle ease-out deceleration. When the like button is tapped, a small red heart scales up elastically and settles back down.
